offset.caveat: Stated jointly for both sub-clusters ('offsets in both northern and southern sub-clusters') and in §5 as a MEAN over mass-vs-luminosity/number-density peaks; approximate ('~'); which galaxy tracer (luminosity vs number density) is not specified in the abstract sentence.

I.location: Abstract; §5 'Two dimensional mass reconstruction'; §7.3 'Mass-Galaxy Offset' (Fig. 9 centroid bootstrap, Fig. 10 offset significance, Table 3 p-values; mass-over-galaxy map is Fig. 5). No coordinates given.
I.quote: Abstract: 'When the mass and galaxy centroids are compared in detail, we detect ~1′ (~190 kpc) offsets in both northern and southern sub-clusters.' §5: 'It is apparent that the mass centroids do not perfectly align with the cluster galaxies. The mean offset between the mass and luminosity/number density peaks is ~1′.' §7.3: 'The comparison of the mass and galaxy centroids in CIZA J2242.8+5301 shows that on average they are offset by ~1′.'

G.quote: No X-ray peak position or mass-X-ray offset is given; the only X-ray statements are qualitative, e.g. §7.3: 'As seen in Figure~1, the X-ray emission is more centrally concentrated than the cluster galaxies, which may imply that a significant fraction of ICM may be present between the two halos'.

notes: No subcluster coordinates are tabulated anywhere in the paper (Table 1 = 1D NFW/SIS mass fits, Table 2 = simultaneous 2D fit masses, Table 3 = offset p-values). The only coordinates given are the overall cluster position '(α,δ)=(22h42m49.1s, 53°00′51″)' (§2, from Kocevski et al. 2007) and the mean position of the two halos '(22h42m47.3s, 53°01′56″)' (§6) — neither is a northern-subcluster I, G or S position. Only an approximate I-S offset (~1′ ~190 kpc, 'in both' subclusters / 'mean') is stated; no numerical positional uncertainties (only figure contours; 'the northern galaxy-luminosity–mass offset is significant at the ≳2σ level', p=0.082). No X-ray (G) position. Also, the 'luminosity center' is from a smoothed luminosity map and is variously called 'luminosity peak'/'luminosity centroid' by the authors — ambiguous with respect to the protocol's centroid-vs-peak rule; no BCG position given. Pointer mismatch: Table 1 contains masses, not positions; §3.2 is 'CFHT/MegaCam Data Reduction'.
